name: Cape Town and the Winelands
tagline: A mountain in the city, two oceans, and vineyards an hour away.
distinctive: Few cities combine a mountain, two oceans and a great wine region so closely. Chapman's Peak Drive and the road to Cape Point are among the world's most spectacular coastal routes.

image.alt: Illustration of a flat-topped mountain above the ocean with a pale car on a coastal road

moodNotes.drive: Chapman's Peak Drive and the Cape Peninsula loop are some of the most beautiful roads anywhere.
moodNotes.lifetime: Table Mountain, penguins at Boulders Beach and whales in season, all in one journey.
moodNotes.sea: Atlantic beaches on one side and the warmer False Bay on the other.
moodNotes.city: A lively dining scene and Zeitz MOCAA on the waterfront.
moodNotes.weekend: Long-haul from most departure points. Give it at least a week.

seasonNote: The southern summer, roughly October to April, is warm and dry. Winter brings rain, and whale season along the coast.

arrival.transfer: Allow roughly 20–30 minutes by road to the city centre or the Atlantic seaboard, traffic permitting.
arrival.groundNote: Traffic drives on the left. Take local advice on where and when to drive, as you would in any large city.

driving.note: Traffic drives on the left. Chapman's Peak Drive is a toll road that can close in bad weather, so check its status before setting out. Use a driver on wine-tasting days.

carWhy: An open roof for the Atlantic coast and composure on the mountain passes into the Winelands.

transfer.label: Driver for the Winelands
transfer.why: Tasting and driving do not mix. Take a driver for the vineyard day.

stay.name: Ellerman House
stay.why: An intimate hotel in a historic house on the Atlantic seaboard, known for its collection of South African art.

watchWhy: A long-haul journey calls for a second time zone. The GMT keeps home in view while you adjust to the Cape.
aromaWhy: Fynbos botanicals such as buchu and rooibos with sea salt: the Cape's own scent, herbal and bright.

days.title: Table Mountain
days.text: Take the cableway early while the weather allows, then spend the afternoon at Zeitz MOCAA on the waterfront.

days.title: Chapman's Peak and the Cape
days.text: Drive Chapman's Peak to Cape Point, returning via the penguins at Boulders Beach.

days.title: The Winelands
days.text: Take a driver to Franschhoek and Stellenbosch for tastings and a long lunch among the vines.

moreDays.title: Hermanus
moreDays.text: Between roughly June and November, watch southern right whales from the cliffs.

moreDays.title: Kirstenbosch
moreDays.text: Spend a morning at the botanical garden on the mountain's eastern slopes.
